title: YouTube Script
description: Structured output of the script-generation (and script-revision) LLM call — the JSONB stored in script_versions.content. Every factual narration-bearing unit must carry source_ids/claim_ids copied exactly from the approved research package; `cited_source_ids`/`cited_claim_ids` must list the union of every id referenced anywhere in this document — checked by script_grounding_report() against `sources`/`research_claims`, never trusted from the LLM. Structured enough for later TTS/visual-planning/captioning/rendering stages without redesign; nothing here fetches or generates media — visual/on-screen-text fields are planning metadata only. See docs/architecture/script-pipeline.md#structured-script-contract.

narration.description: Natural spoken narration text. May be an empty string only for a purely visual beat — deterministic QC penalizes this.

source_ids.description: source_id values (from the approved research package) that ground any factual content in this unit's narration.

claim_ids.description: claim_id values (from the approved research package) that ground any factual content in this unit's narration.

pronunciation_notes.description: Acronyms, uncommon names, technical terms, or foreign words in this unit's narration that Step 8 (TTS) should be aware of. No pronunciation conversion happens here — just preserved for later use.

note.description: e.g. a phonetic hint or 'pronounced as written' — free text, no fixed IPA/phoneme system enforced.

section_id.description: Stable within this script version — Step 8/9 workflows depend on it. Not derived from array position.

section_type.description: 'opinion' and 'commentary' are the only types exempt from the missing-reference deterministic check — see docs/architecture/script-pipeline.md#unsupported-fact-detection.

purpose.description: Why this section exists in the narrative — retention/pacing rationale, not shown to the viewer.

on_screen_text.description: Concise — a statistic, key term, date, or name, not a narration duplicate. Deterministic QC flags entries over ~60 characters.

transition.description: How this section transitions to the next — deterministic QC flags identical transitions repeated across consecutive sections.

viewer_promise.description: What the viewer gets for staying — must be honest, not a fabricated stake.

narration.description: The hook's full spoken narration (opening_line + tension_or_question + viewer_promise + curiosity_loop + transition_into_body, composed into natural speech). Factual assertions here are NOT exempt from grounding — see docs/architecture/script-pipeline.md#hook-structure.

cta_type.description: Must match the channel's configured CTA goal — the generator scripts only the configured type, never an unconfigured monetization offer.

title_concept.description: A working title/concept — not final YouTube metadata (title/description/tags are a later step).

estimated_word_count.description: The LLM's own estimate — deterministic QC independently recomputes this from narration_text and compares.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: The LLM's own estimate — not trusted alone; deterministic QC computes an independent word-count-based estimate and penalizes large deviations between the two.

cited_source_ids.description: Union of every source_id referenced anywhere in this document (hook, intro, every section, outro, cta). Checked against `sources` by script_grounding_report() — never trusted as-is.

cited_claim_ids.description: Union of every claim_id referenced anywhere in this document. Checked against `research_claims` by script_grounding_report() — never trusted as-is.
